supersedes: docs/m34d4/d4a_reachability_recovery.md (wlc_phy_init is a no-op for AC)

correction.claim: wlc_phy_init DOES execute for BCM4352 rev42 AC; it is the real AC PHY/radio init entry, reached from sub_6656c on the vendor up path.
correction.root_cause_of_previous_error: pi_fptr slots in wlc_phy_attach_acphy are initialised by relocation-covered imm32 (`movq $imm,disp(%rbx)`); the raw object bytes are 0 and were misread as NULL. The relocations install real functions.

relocation_evidence.oracle: objdump -r + readelf .rela.text + re field_sites (reloc EXACT, src=wlc_phy_attach_acphy)

pi+0x110.name: radio_cb
pi+0x110.evidence: no field_sites writer other than memset; AC takes explicit 0xba3a1 branch to wlc_phy_switch_radio_acphy

pi+0x118.name: anacore_cb
pi+0x118.evidence: no field_sites writer other than memset; wlc_phy_anacore AC fallback writes D11 0x3e6

consumers.runtime: AC reaches here, rax=sub_8e77a (6-byte ret stub)

reachability_chain_post_d3b: sub_6656c 0x669df -> wlc_phy_init(pi, chanspec)  # dl=0 so the phyrev>0x27 skip at 0x669c7 is NOT taken
wlc_phy_init 0xbad4c -> sub_b018f(pi)  # AC PHY init callback

sub_6656c_wlc_phy_init_guard.asm: 0x669c2 test r13b,r13b; 0x669c5 je 0x669d0; 0x669c7 cmp dword [rbx+0x84],0x27; 0x669ce ja 0x669e4
sub_6656c_wlc_phy_init_guard.meaning: r13b==0 => always call wlc_phy_init; r13b!=0 => call only if phyrev<=0x27
sub_6656c_wlc_phy_init_guard.initial_up_value: wlc_bmac_init @0x695d3 xor edx,edx => dl=0 => wlc_phy_init IS called for rev42

manual_used: objdump -r (independent relocation verification; justified by the re/manual conflict on relocated imm32)
